Zidane's first France training session; Mbappé misses due to flu

France's national football team began preparations for the Nations League under new head coach Zinedine Zidane, who conducted his first training session. Star forward Kylian Mbappé missed the session because he was suffering from the flu. Mbappé said he wants to win his first Ballon d’Or. Former player and coach Guy Lacombe said Zidane is trying to win over the players without imposing his views.
